title: Roasted Australian Lamb with Earthy Stir Fry
description: Experience the flavors of the Australian outback with this hearty roasted lamb recipe, paired with an earthy stir fry.
instructions: Season the lamb leg with salt and pepper.
Heat 1 tbsp of grapeseed oil in a large oven-safe pan over medium-high heat.
Sear the lamb leg for 2-3 minutes on each side, then transfer to the oven.
Roast the lamb for 20 minutes per kilogram, or until it reaches an internal temperature of 65°C (150°F).
While the lamb is cooking, heat the remaining 1 tbsp of grapeseed oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Add the chopped onion and cook for 3-4 minutes, or until softened.
Add the sliced mushrooms and cook for an additional 2-3 minutes.
Add the chopped thyme and cook for 1 minute, stirring constantly.
To serve, slice the roasted lamb and serve with the earthy stir fry.
Serve with roasted carrots and potatoes on the side.
